d:
Move through physical discomfort and mental noise so you finish feeling stronger, more grounded, and noticeably better in your body. This dynamic Vinyasa combines full body strength, balance, mobility, and rhythmic movement with slow breathing to pull your attention out of constant thinking and into what you can actually feel.
Challenge has a way of making the voice in your head louder. Stay with your breath through the difficult moments and notice how differently you experience yourself when that noise begins to settle.
